Name: Red Overalls with White Shirt
Author: Hildegard333
Description:
Two pairs of red overalls for Fashion Sense - one bright, the other faded a bit.

I have found that I actually really like doing pixel art, so if you'd like another edit of in game clothes, I'll do my best to try more of these types of edits! I am still really quite new to this, but have done other types of recolors of my own, like furniture. Some items have a lot of sprites and take a long time, so depending on what you request, I may or may not do it.
